result_text:
The per-extension entries are now named by the bare lower-cased extension (`"java"`, `"js"`, `"xml"`), and the metric ids are unchanged (`MAIN_EXT_JAVA` and so on). All 330 `codeanalyzer` tests pass offline. I did not commit.

- **`SourceCodeAspectUtils.java`**: the per-extension aspect is named `extension` instead of `"  *." + extension`.
- **`AnalysisUtils.java`**: the metric id is built from the bare name, so the ids come out the same as before. The textual summary still prints the indented `  *.java: N files` look.
- **`LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`**: a new `toBareExtension` helper strips `*.` and trims/lower-cases the name. It is applied in the per-extension aggregation and in `merge()`, so old `"  *.java"` data and new `"java"` data collapse into one entry for both main and the merged other category. The per-repository description list is unchanged, so each contributing repository still appears.
- **Tests**: `CodeConfigurationTest` and `NamedSourceCodeAspectTest` now expect `"java"`, `"js"`, `"html"`.

I left the `.replace("*.", "")` calls in the `reports` module alone, since they are outside the files you listed. They are now no-ops on the new names and still work on old ones. The `reports` module was not rebuilt or tested.
